objective_value: <float> Total cost comprising initial inventory penalties, setup costs, variable production costs, and inventory holding costs across all products and periods.

variables.production: <list[list[float]], shape [num_products][num_periods]> Quantity of each product produced in each period.
variables.setup: <list[list[int]], shape [num_products][num_periods]> Whether production of each product is initiated in each period (1 = yes, 0 = no).
variables.inventory: <list[list[float]], shape [num_products][num_periods]> Quantity of each product held in inventory at the end of each period.
variables.initial_inventory: <list[float], length num_products> Quantity of each product available in inventory at the start of the first period.
